_what: Overlap of this paper's 12 structures with the live corpus, measured three ways. Report, do not act.

substructure_near_misses.query: the bis(8-((2-hexyldecanoyl)oxy)octyl)amine core shared by all 12 members
substructure_near_misses.interpretation: These are NOT overlap. They are quaternised cholesterol conjugates built on this paper's Lipid 14 by a different group (ZT_2026, Tian 2026). Their value is as an INDEPENDENT corroboration of Lipid 14's scaffold from outside this paper: their IL_SMILES carry ...CCOC(=O)CCC[N+](C)(C)..., three CH2 between the ester carbonyl and the head nitrogen, i.e. the 4-(dimethylamino)butyric acid arm. That is what retired our own first misreading of Lipid 14 (08_contradictions.csv row 1).

conclusion: ZERO overlap on every identity test. All 12 lipids would be new to the corpus.
